title: This Air Purifier Cleans Itself—and Your Cat Can Sit on It!
summary: If you have a cat or dog, you know the struggle: fur everywhere! Air purifiers can help, but cleaning their filters is a messy, never-ending chore. What if a purifier could clean itself? Meet the Dreame FP10—the first air purifier with a 360-degree self-cleaning roller. It sweeps away fur and dust so you don't have to! This sleek tower looks more like furniture than an appliance. It's whisper-quiet, so it won't scare your pets. And get this: it has a flat tabletop that's perfect for your cat to sit on. The base is super sturdy, so even a zooming dog won't knock it over. Plus, you can swap the tabletop for a special pet-weighing tray (coming soon). It records your pet's weight and sleep habits, and even adjusts the fan speed to keep them comfy. In tests, the FP10 removed 99.97% of tiny particles and 99.9% of pet odors. The only downsides? It's a bit pricey, and the control buttons are small and hard to read in dim light. But if you're tired of vacuuming filters and want a purifier that your cat will love as much as you do, this might be your dream machine.
why_it_matters: If you have a pet that sheds fur, an air purifier like this could help keep your home clean, and your cat might get a cozy new napping spot.

keywords.explanation: A self-cleaning roller is a spinning brush inside the purifier that automatically wipes away fur and dust.
Dreame FP10 is the model name of this special air purifier with a flat top and pet-friendly features.
A pet-weighing tray is an add-on platform that can measure how heavy your cat or dog is when they step on it.
Particles are extremely tiny bits of dust, pollen, or smoke floating in the air that you can't usually see.
Odors are smells, like those from pet fur or litter boxes, that can make a room stink.
Fan speed is how quickly the purifier's fan spins, which changes how fast it cleans the air.
